column3: “To the king” may be read as “to Molech”; NASB has “the king.” “Showed abasement to Sheol” is rendered “made them go down to Sheol.”
“The life of your hand” is rendered “renewed strength.”
“Your collections” is rendered “your collection of idols.”
“I hid” is rendered “I hid My face,” supplying “My face.”
“The fruit of the lips” is rendered “the praise of the lips,” following a different reading.
